name: reliability
description: Fail-closed reliability guards for Claude Code. Universal rules apply in every project: recognised destructive operations, unbounded mutation, edits to the configuration governing the agent, and attempts to disable this plugin are denied. A repository may add to them with .claude/reliability-policy.json — reviewed-script pinning, extra protected paths, and verified contract delivery to subagents. A guard that cannot run, answers late, or answers unreadably is treated as a refusal, never as permission. Repository policy can only add restrictions; it can never weaken a universal rule.
